"""Models for the protein plugin, generated by `iki plugin build` from its manifests.

Don't edit this file: change the manifests, then run `iki plugin makemigrations`.
"""

# ruff: noqa
# fmt: off
import datetime

from django.contrib.postgres.fields import ArrayField
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Q
from django.db.models.functions import Length
from django.db.models.lookups import GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual

from iki_server.entities import checks
from iki_server.entities.fields import QuantityField
from iki_server.entities.models import Entity
from iki_server.files.models import Blob

import iki_plugin_dna.models


class Protein(iki_plugin_dna.models.Sequence):
    """Protein (protein.Protein), schema version 3."""

    IKI_TYPE = 'protein.Protein'

    sequence_ptr = models.OneToOneField(
        iki_plugin_dna.models.Sequence,
        models.PROTECT,
        parent_link=True,
        primary_key=True,
        db_column='entity_id',
        related_name='+',
    )
    sequence = models.TextField()
    molecular_weight = QuantityField(unit='u', null=True, db_index=True)
    organism = models.CharField(max_length=200, null=True, db_index=True)
    source = models.ForeignKey(Entity, models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)
    encoded_by = models.ForeignKey('dna.DNASequence', models.PROTECT, related_name='+', null=True)
    temperature_optimum = QuantityField(unit='Cel', null=True)
    uniprot_ids = ArrayField(models.TextField(), null=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'protein_protein'
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('sequence'), 1),
                name='protein_protein__sequence__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(sequence__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='protein_protein__sequence__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(
                    sequence__regex='^[ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWYBZXUOJacdefghiklmnpqrstvwybzxuoj*]*$',
                ),
                name='protein_protein__sequence__format',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(molecular_weight__gt=float('-inf'), molecular_weight__lt=float('inf')),
                name='protein_protein__molecular_weight__finite',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('organism'), 1),
                name='protein_protein__organism__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(organism__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='protein_protein__organism__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(
                    temperature_optimum__gt=float('-inf'),
                    temperature_optimum__lt=float('inf'),
                ),
                name='protein_protein__temperature_optimum__finite',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.IsPlainList('uniprot_ids'),
                name='protein_protein__uniprot_ids__plain_list',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.AllLengthsBetween('uniprot_ids', 1, None),
                name='protein_protein__uniprot_ids__item_length',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.NoneMatch('uniprot_ids', '[\\r\\n]'),
                name='protein_protein__uniprot_ids__item_one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=checks.AllMatch('uniprot_ids', '^(?:^[A-Z0-9]{6,10}$)$'),
                name='protein_protein__uniprot_ids__item_pattern',
            ),
        ]


class Protein_History(models.Model):
    """The history of protein_protein: its values at each revision of each entity."""

    IKI_HISTORY_OF = 'Protein'
    APPEND_ONLY = True

    pk = models.CompositePrimaryKey('entity_id', 'revision')
    entity_id = models.UUIDField()
    revision = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    sequence = models.TextField(null=True)
    molecular_weight = QuantityField(unit='u', null=True)
    organism = models.TextField(null=True)
    source = models.UUIDField(db_column='source_id', null=True)
    encoded_by = models.UUIDField(db_column='encoded_by_id', null=True)
    temperature_optimum = QuantityField(unit='Cel', null=True)
    uniprot_ids = ArrayField(models.TextField(), null=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'protein_protein__history'


class ProteinStructure(Entity):
    """Protein Structure (protein.ProteinStructure), schema version 1."""

    IKI_TYPE = 'protein.ProteinStructure'

    entity = models.OneToOneField(
        Entity,
        models.PROTECT,
        parent_link=True,
        primary_key=True,
        db_column='entity_id',
        related_name='+',
    )
    structure = models.ForeignKey(Blob, models.PROTECT, related_name='+')
    method = models.TextField(null=True)
    resolution = QuantityField(unit='Ao', null=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'protein_proteinstructure'
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(method__in=['xray', 'nmr', 'cryo_em', 'predicted']),
                name='protein_proteinstructure__method__values',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(resolution__gt=float('-inf'), resolution__lt=float('inf')),
                name='protein_proteinstructure__resolution__finite',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(resolution__gte=0),
                name='protein_proteinstructure__resolution__min',
            ),
        ]


class ProteinStructure_History(models.Model):
    """The history of protein_proteinstructure: its values at each revision of each entity."""

    IKI_HISTORY_OF = 'ProteinStructure'
    APPEND_ONLY = True

    pk = models.CompositePrimaryKey('entity_id', 'revision')
    entity_id = models.UUIDField()
    revision = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    structure = models.UUIDField(db_column='structure_id', null=True)
    method = models.TextField(null=True)
    resolution = QuantityField(unit='Ao', null=True)
    chains = ArrayField(models.UUIDField(), null=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'protein_proteinstructure__history'


class ProteinStructure_chains(models.Model):
    """The items of protein.ProteinStructure.chains, in order."""

    IKI_LIST_OF = ('ProteinStructure', 'chains')

    pk = models.CompositePrimaryKey('entity', 'position')
    entity = models.ForeignKey(
        'ProteinStructure',
        models.CASCADE,
        db_column='entity_id',
        related_name='+',
    )
    position = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    item = models.ForeignKey('Protein', models.PROTECT, related_name='+')

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'protein_proteinstructure__chains'
